conceptual_change: Introduce a regime-neutralizing filter for cointegration-based mean reversion by comparing the current 3-period rolling mean of vwap_distance against the 20-period rolling mean, effectively measuring local deviation from the price-weighted mean.
rationale: Statistical arbitrage based on cointegration requires a filter to ensure that mean reversion occurs from a point of statistical extremity. Comparing short-term to medium-term vwap_distance provides a local signal of transient displacement that is decoupled from long-term cointegration drift.
